name: Extract IOCs
description: Extract hashes, IPs, domains, URLs and email addresses from text or a file, refanging defanged forms such as hxxp and [.]. Unlike every other action here, this never calls the PolySwarm API: local only, costs nothing, spends no quota.

text.description: Text to extract indicators from, up to 5 MB. Supply this or a file, not both. Nothing is sent to PolySwarm: this runs locally and spends no quota.

file.description: Name of a text file to extract indicators from, relative to the run data directory where Sekoia delivers it, up to 5 MB. Supply this or text, not both. Nothing is sent to PolySwarm: this runs locally and spends no quota.

ipv4.description: Routable IPv4 addresses found in the text

ipv6.description: Routable IPv6 addresses found in the text

domain.description: Domain names found on their own, excluding those that only appear inside a URL or an email address

url.description: URLs found in the text, refanged and with trailing sentence punctuation removed

md5.description: MD5 hashes found in the text

sha1.description: SHA1 hashes found in the text

sha256.description: SHA256 hashes found in the text

email.description: Email addresses found in the text

reserved_ip.description: Private, loopback, link local, multicast and other reserved addresses, reported separately from the routable ones rather than dropped

skipped_filenames.description: Bare names that end in a top level domain and were not reported as domains because they look like a file. These labels (zip, mov, sh, py, md and others) are both real top level domains and common file extensions, so the action cannot tell report.zip the file from report.zip the domain, and it lists the name here instead of guessing. They are not counted in total_count.

total_count.description: Total number of indicators returned across every list, including the reserved addresses and excluding skipped_filenames
